items.title: Manny Gabriel Interview, 1965-07-27
items.q: Such as, you know Suga? No.

ctx.x: He was a good trumpet player. And so he played. And Michael Perez taking him in the band. And after he got through the orchestra with Kid Orwell, he was fast. He always heard that monkey shine. And he went up the line. He sent him out of scrum. There was a whole lot of fellas around here that could play old time fellas. Such as, you know Suga? No. That was a time I wanted to play over the river. Jack Pyee? No.
